name: ssl-for-code
description: Real-time Python code autocompletion powered by a self-supervised Transformer-XL language model.

sslForCode.serverHost.description: Hostname of the running SSL-For-Code Flask inference server.

sslForCode.serverPort.description: Port of the running SSL-For-Code Flask inference server.

sslForCode.contextLines.description: Number of preceding lines sent as context to the autocomplete model.

sslForCode.confidenceRatio.description: Prune lower-ranked completions when top probability exceeds the next by this ratio.
